findings.text: non-blocking: the refusal raised by the widened shape check at :796 still reads "the averaged external field must be finite (cells, 2) components" although a linear-basis call is now required to hand in (cells, 6), so a linear-basis shape error names the wrong expected shape.

non-blocking: assert_array_equal(result.fill_fraction, fill) at :1099 and the cross_field_factor line at :1100 compare the solver's stored fields against the very arrays the test passed in, so they stay green under a resolver that only echoes its argument; the fill law's durability rests on the independent analytic assertion at :1094, not on these two.

non-blocking: validate_control_receipt(_CONTROL_RECEIPT, _CONTROL_REVISION) reads a fixed /work/production/... receipt through scripts/iron_limb_production/gate.py:15 with no skip guard, unlike the established idiom at tests/test_magnetisation.py:421 (pytest.skip when the evidence root is unmounted), so on a host without /work mounted the four control-receipt tests raise FileNotFoundError instead of skipping.
